dataset_metadata.name: UofM Pouch Cell Voltage and Expansion Cyclic Aging Dataset
dataset_metadata.citation: Mohtat, P., Siegel, J. B., Stefanopoulou, A. G., Lee, S. (2021). UofM Pouch Cell Voltage and Expansion Cyclic Aging Dataset [Data set], University of Michigan - Deep Blue Data. https://doi.org/10.7302/7tw1-kc35
dataset_metadata.funding: National Science Foundation grant No. 1762247; Automotive Research Center (ARC) Cooperative Agreement W56HZV-14-2-0001 U.S. Army CCDC GVSC

cell_info.electrolyte: 1 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7) with 2% additive
cell_info.cell_notes: Custom-built pouch cell fabricated at University of Michigan Battery Lab (UMBL). Positive electrode: NMC111:CB:PVDF (94:3:3), 14 double-sided sheets, 18.5 mg/cm2 loading, 67 um thick. Negative electrode: Graphite:PVDF (95:5), 15 double-sided sheets, 8.55 mg/cm2 loading, 62 um thick. Operating voltage 3.0-4.2 V. Volume 47.52 cm3. Cells manufactured in one batch to minimize cell-to-cell variation (std ~1.2% of nominal capacity).

aging_modes.notes: 7 condition groups (A-G) each with 3 cells at room (25 C), cold (-5 C), and hot (45 C) temperatures (21 cells); plus group H (10 cells) studying pressure effects at 45 C with varying applied pressures (1-25 PSI / 6.9-172.4 kPa) at 2C/2C, 0-100% DOD. Cells cycled to at least 70% capacity retention. Pressure applied via custom fixture with compression springs maintaining pseudo-constant pressure. Test date coverage: 2019-03-01 to 2020-08-01.

time_protocol.notes: Data sampled at 10-second intervals (0.1 Hz) for both cycling (Biologic BT-Lab software via LAN) and expansion (custom LabView program via serial port). Cells held at rest 3 hours before each test for thermal equilibrium. Test date coverage 2019-03-01 to 2020-08-01.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Four CSV files per cell: cycling_wExpansion.csv, OCV_wExpansion.csv, Crate_wExpansion.csv, Resistance.csv. Expansion (cell thickness displacement in micrometers) recorded as additional custom variable alongside standard electrical signals.

checkup.notes: RPT performed after a number of cycles corresponding to an expected 5% capacity loss. RPT includes: (1) C/20 charge-discharge cycle (pseudo-OCV); (2) HPPC with 1C pulses (10 s discharge, 10 min rest, 10 s discharge) at 10% SOC intervals from 100% to 0% SOC, with EIS at 10 mHz-10 kHz at each SOC point; (3) C-rate dependency test with CC charges at C/10, C/5, C/2, and 1C. All RPTs performed at room temperature (25 C). Checkup interval is approximately every 5% capacity loss.

notes: This dataset focuses on the simultaneous measurement of electrical and mechanical (cell thickness expansion) response of custom-built NMC111/graphite pouch cells under a wide range of cycling stress conditions. A specialized fixture maintained pseudo-constant pressure (~34.5 kPa / 5 PSI for most groups) using compression springs. The pressure study group (H) tested 6.9, 34.5, 68.9, 103.4, 137.9, and 172.4 kPa at 45 C with 2C charge/discharge. The drive cycle for group G is a synthetic urban commute combining UDDS, HWFETx2, US06x2, HWFETx2, UDDS at 50% DOD. Both reversible (intercalation-induced) and irreversible (SEI/plating/cracking) expansion components are tracked. Data also available via DOI: https://doi.org/10.7302/7tw1-kc35.
